## Finishes

Any colour is a material: `#rrggbb/finish`, where the finish is one of `paint`, `metal`, `plastic`, `rubber`, `fabric`, `wood`, `plaster`, `concrete`, `stone`, `glow`, `glass` (paint when left off). `glow` is lit and full bright; `glass` is see-through.
